messages:
miriam_sales: FYI — exec escalation for HelixMed POC. CISO asking for KMS BYO, SAML SSO proof, and a hard cap on pilot spending. Legal + Security need answers before next Tue. Quick help pls.

jay_se: Got it. We support BYO KMS in Private; need to confirm for Dedicated. @anya_ciso can you confirm the minimal attestation we can share? Also what's the acceptable concession on pricing?

anya_ciso: CISO here — need KMS auth flow diagram + HSM/FIPS attestation. I'll complete the security questionnaire once we have the attestation doc. Link to current questionnaire: https://redwood-internal/qsa/helixmed-2026

sam_sre: I can pull the KMS flow and attestation from infra. cc @deploy-bot please create ticket so we can attach artifacts.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-6723 created by sam_sre: https://tracker.redwood/INF-6723

jay_se: Pricing ask from the customer: pilot cap $5k/month for 3 months. CFO needs exec signoff for a credit. @julia_cto can we grant an exception or credit?

julia_cto: We can offer a $5k credit if engineering signs off on data residency + SLA. Need a 1-paragraph writeup from sales that states what we must guarantee.

miriam_sales: I'll draft that paragraph. Also legal flagged an IP retention clause — @neil_reliability can you confirm whether we can commit to 30d log retention for the POC?

neil_reliability: We can set retention to 30d in Dedicated but it needs a product config toggle. ETA: scheduling + 1 day test. Estimate ~= 2 engineer-days. Example config: ```
retention_days: 30
log_level: error
```

anya_ciso: If we get the KMS flow + HSM cert and a 30d retention note, I can sign off on security questionnaire.

miriam_sales: Action items — (1) sam attach KMS flow + HSM -> INF-6723 (2) neil confirm retention ETA by EOD (3) jay provide 1-paragraph for CTO (4) legal review SOW to add 30d retention + "no export of model weights" clause. Target: exec sign-off by Fri COB.

sam_sre: Done — attached to INF-6723: /artifacts/helixmed/kms_flow_v1.pdf and HSM_attestation_2026.pdf

deploy-bot: INF-6723 updated: attachments added by sam_sre.

julia_cto: Received the sales paragraph (thanks @miriam_sales). Approve $5k credit contingent on legal SOW change and security signoff. @miriam_sales please escalate to legal.

miriam_sales: Looping in @legal_ops — can we expedite a SOW redline to include 30d retention and explicit "no model-weight export" language? Customer also requests no data escrow. Need redline by tomorrow.

legal_ops: On it. I'll prioritize and target a redline by tomorrow noon. Add any customer-specific wording here and I'll include it.

miriam_sales: Customer asks: confirm no model weights exported, logs only used for debugging. Can we put that in SOW?

legal_ops: We'll add an explicit "no export of model weights" clause and the 30d retention. Will reference the KMS BYO attestation doc in SOW and cc @julia_cto on the redline.

anya_ciso: Once legal redline is in and artifacts are present in INF-6723, I will sign the security questionnaire. Should be clear to close.

miriam_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll update the exec sponsor and schedule a sync with HelixMed for Monday. If any blockers pop up ping me directly.
